messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: SEV2 — billing/usage-metering pipeline lag. Symptoms: delayed usage ingestion, inconsistent token counts, invoices may be blocked. PagerDuty: https://pd.example/INC12345 — escalation to on-call SRE and Billing Engs.

pagerduty: PagerDuty alert created (INC12345). Trigger: throughput drop + >10m consumer lag in billing-ingest. Priority: P2.

Alice Chen: ack. I'm on it, grabbing logs and looking at consumer groups.

Mateo S: joining — I saw spikes earlier in the ingest lag dashboard, looks like the kafka consumer for `usage-ingest` lost a partition assignment. Could be broker GC or scaling noise.

Priya N: several support tickets inbound: ACME Corp and BetaCloud reporting "invoice processing stalled" and "usage shows 0 for past hour". Ticket IDs: #3421, #3423.

Jonah K: running consumer group check now:
```
$ kafka-consumer-groups.sh --bootstrap-server broker-prod:9092 --describe --group usage-ingest
TOPIC           PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG  CONSUMER-ID
usage.events     12         12451234        12461234        10000  consumer-3
```
That's a ~10k lag on partition 12.

Mateo S: here's a short log tail from the consumer pod (`usage-ingest-3`) around the time we saw the drop:
```
2025-11-02T09:12:07Z ERROR Fetch error: java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: GC overhead limit exceeded
2025-11-02T09:12:08Z WARN Rebalancing consumer group usage-ingest
2025-11-02T09:12:09Z INFO Consumer paused, reason=backpressure
```

Alice Chen: GC OOM in consumer — likely caused partition stall. Quick mitigation: restart consumer pod and trigger rebalance. I'll coordinate the restart and watch lag.

Carmen Reyes: finance ops — if this isn't fixed in 30m we have invoices blocked for customers on monthly billing. We may need manual export to avoid missed invoices. Who can prepare a safe manual token reconciliation?

Mateo S: I can script a manual reconciliation from raw events (S3 backfill) but that'll take ~20-40m to validate. Immediate step: rolling restart of `usage-ingest` deployment to clear OOM state.

Alice Chen: executing restart now —
```
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/usage-ingest
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=usage-ingest -w
```

Alice Chen: pod restart started. Watching consumer lag.

incident-bot: automated checkpoint — mitigation action `restart_deployment` recorded by Alice Chen.

Jonah K: pod came back up, consumer rejoined. Re-checking group:
```
$ kafka-consumer-groups.sh --bootstrap-server broker-prod:9092 --describe --group usage-ingest
TOPIC           PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG  CONSUMER-ID
usage.events     12         12461234        12461234        0  consumer-1
```
lag trending down to 0 for that partition.

Priya N: support update drafted: "We’re seeing delayed ingestion due to a consumer restart; invoices are processing now and any missing invoices will be caught up shortly." Sending to ACME and BetaCloud. :mailbox_with_mail:

Carmen Reyes: copy — if the replay finishes cleanly we can avoid manual invoice runs. Please update me once backlog is <1k tokens.

Mateo S: backlog currently ~450k tokens across partitions; estimated catch-up ~12 minutes at current throughput. I'm running a consumer-monitoring check and confirming no duplicated counts.

Alice Chen: monitoring shows regen of offsets and KV-cache warming. I'm going to handoff to Mateo for the next 2 hours to watch replays and reconcile counts. If anything spikes again, page me.

Mateo S: taking handoff. Checklist I'm running: 1) verify no duplicate acking 2) validate token counts against S3 events snapshot 3) ensure consumer heap args bumped if needed. I'll post commands I ran.

Mateo S: commands for heap bump (if we need to adjust):
```
kubectl -n prod set env deployment/usage-ingest JAVA_OPTS='-Xms2g -Xmx4g -XX:+UseG1GC'
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/usage-ingest
```

incident-bot: PagerDuty note — INC12345 acknowledged by Alice Chen and assigned to Mateo S for mitigation.

finance-ops-bot: Alert from billing pipeline: invoicing queue length = 0 (now processing); last processed invoice time = 2025-11-02T09:28:10Z.

Priya N: support update posted to customers. Ticket #3421 moved to "monitoring".

Carmen Reyes: thanks — will hold off manual invoicing for now. Please DM me if you need finance sign-off for any manual pushes.

Mateo S: replay finished. Summary: backlog fully consumed, token counts aligned with S3 snapshot within acceptable variance (~0.3%). No duplicated invoices found in audit logs.

Alice Chen: closing the loop — did we identify root cause? Mateo?

Mateo S: root cause hypothesis: one consumer pod hit GC OOM due to memory fragmentation caused by a recent config change to batch size + a rare large event. Action items: 1) revert batch size change on `usage-ingest` config 2) add a safety heap bump to prod 3) add alert for consumer OOM logs to trigger earlier (lower threshold). I'll open a follow-up Jira: BILLING-912.

Alice Chen: thanks. I'll mark the PD incident status -> resolved (mitigation complete) and handoff notes to postmortem.

pagerduty: Incident INC12345 updated — status: resolved. Resolved by Alice Chen at 2025-11-02T09:34:50Z.

Priya N: creating the customer-facing post-incident note and internal incident ticket for follow-up. Assigning to Mateo S and Alice Chen for RCA.

Carmen Reyes: appreciate the quick response. Please include an explicit invoice sanity check step in the RCA so finance can be confident.

Alice Chen: will do. Handoff summary (for on-call rotations): 1) Mitigation: rollout restart succeeded 2) Impact: temporary invoice processing delay for a subset of customers; no lost tokens 3) Next steps: BILLING-912, add OOM alert, revert batch-size change 4) Owners: Mateo S (replay & RCA), Alice Chen (postmortem + follow-up).

incident-bot: Checkpoint recorded. If any regressions occur, this thread will auto-escalate within 15m. :white_check_mark:

Mateo S: I'm keeping an eye on it for the next 2 hours, will update in this thread if anything changes.

Alice Chen: thank you all — closing my on-call shift.
